commit.message:
ci: run the one local check and nothing else (0154)

`pnpm check` (build, lint, typecheck, deterministic tests) replaces `verify`;
pre-push and CI's check workflow run exactly it. CI drops the gate, the
full-history fetch, the PATH and projection steps, pack smoke and the pnpm
probe. The orphaned drift-notice shell probe goes; the working conventions
state the check and the supported omp version.
